title: HelmDeck harness agent file (YAML frontmatter of ops/harness/agents/*.md)
description: Follows the Claude Code agent-file convention: YAML frontmatter, then the system prompt as the markdown body. HelmDeck adds `settings` and `ask_protocol`. The BODY is the editable policy; the harness appends the fixed wire protocol itself.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema, so an editor can validate the frontmatter.

name.description: Stable id. daemon/harness.py looks the agent up by this, and it must equal the filename stem.

description.description: One line: which surface this brief is spoken to.

settings.description: Which ops/harness/settings/<name>.json governs a process started with this brief. Absent = no explicit settings layer.

setting_sources.description: Value passed to `claude --setting-sources`. "project" keeps the repo's own .claude/settings.json build-loop hooks while dropping the operator's personal ~/.claude. "" (empty) loads no ambient layer at all. Omit the key entirely to leave the flag off and inherit everything (the pre-harness behaviour).

ask_protocol.description: Append daemon/ask.py's BRIEF (the <helmdeck-ask> wire protocol). The protocol text is deliberately NOT editable here: it is parsed by ask.parse()'s regex, so prompt and parser must ship together. Place it explicitly with a {{ask_protocol}} marker in the body, else it is appended at the end.

model.description: Optional model hint. Advisory only - the driver config and the card's own pick still win.
